name: 微信公众号
description: 管理公众号图文、草稿、发布、评论、消息、粉丝、菜单与运营工作流。

composer.prompt: 使用微信公众号运营插件，先检查账号能力与草稿状态，再按确认范围处理内容、评论、菜单或粉丝互动。

en.name: WeChat Official Account
en.description: Manage WeChat Official Account articles, drafts, publishing, comments, messages, followers, menus, and operational workflows.

composer.prompt: Use the WeChat Official Account operations plugin to check account capabilities and draft status before handling content, comments, menus, or follower interactions within the confirmed scope.

wechat-official-service.label: WeChat Official Account Operations Service
wechat-official-service.description: Call WeChat Official Account content and operations APIs through controlled, confirmable actions.

wechat-official-content.label: Official Account Content Creation
wechat-official-content.description: Create titles, summaries, body copy, and calls to action structured for WeChat Official Account articles.

wechat-official-assets.label: Card and Asset Adaptation
wechat-official-assets.description: Adapt workspace cards and images into cover and body assets for WeChat Official Account articles.

wechat-official-publishing.label: Drafts and Publishing
wechat-official-publishing.description: Manage drafts, previews, publishing confirmation, and publication status.

wechat-official-comments.label: Comment Operations
wechat-official-comments.description: View, filter, reply to, feature, and moderate article comments.

wechat-official-messages.label: Message Automation
wechat-official-messages.description: Design safe direct-message reply policies and send confirmed messages within the currently available customer-service window.

wechat-official-community.label: Follower and Menu Operations
wechat-official-community.description: Understand follower scope and review or update the Official Account custom menu.

wechat-official-review.label: Operations Review
wechat-official-review.description: Summarize operational results and next steps from draft, publishing, and comment evidence.

network.reason: Access WeChat Official Account content, comments, followers, and menu APIs authorized by the user.

workspace-read.reason: Read images selected by the user for upload from the current workspace.

wechat-official-account.label: Connect WeChat Official Account
wechat-official-account.description: Enter the service account AppID and AppSecret. Credentials are stored only in iPolloWork's encrypted authorization store; the account must be verified and have the required API publishing permissions.

permissions.reason: 访问用户授权的微信公众号内容、评论、粉丝与菜单接口。
读取当前工作区中用户选择上传到公众号的图片素材。

methods.label: 连接微信公众号
methods.description: 填写服务号的 AppID 与 AppSecret。凭据仅保存在 iPolloWork 加密授权仓库中；需要具备相应 API 发布权限的认证服务号。

resources.label: 微信公众号运营服务
resources.description: 以受控、可确认的动作调用微信公众号内容与运营 API。

actions.title: 检查公众号连接
actions.description: 验证 AppID 与 AppSecret 是否可获取公众号接口凭据。

actions.title: 上传正文图片
actions.description: 从当前工作区上传一张图片并返回可用于公众号正文的图片 URL。

actions.title: 上传封面图片
actions.description: 从当前工作区上传一张永久图片素材并返回封面 media ID。

actions.title: 创建公众号草稿
actions.description: 将已准备的图文文章写入公众号草稿箱，不会正式发布。

actions.title: 读取公众号草稿
actions.description: 读取一个公众号草稿的完整内容。

actions.title: 列出公众号草稿
actions.description: 分页读取公众号草稿箱的有界摘要。

actions.title: 更新公众号草稿
actions.description: 更新草稿中的一篇文章；执行前应先读取当前草稿。

actions.title: 提交公众号发布
actions.description: 将一个草稿提交到公众号发布队列；执行前必须获得用户明确确认。

actions.title: 查询公众号发布状态
actions.description: 读取一个发布任务的状态、文章 ID 与链接。

actions.title: 查看文章评论
actions.description: 分页读取指定已发布文章的评论。

actions.title: 回复文章评论
actions.description: 回复一条公众号文章评论；执行前必须获得用户明确确认。

actions.title: 设置精选评论
actions.description: 将评论设为精选或取消精选。

actions.title: 删除文章评论
actions.description: 删除一条文章评论；这是不可逆操作，执行前必须获得用户明确确认。

actions.title: 开启或关闭文章评论
actions.description: 为已发布文章开启或关闭评论能力。

actions.title: 列出公众号关注者
actions.description: 分页读取公众号关注者 OpenID 列表。

actions.title: 读取公众号菜单
actions.description: 读取当前生效的公众号自定义菜单。

actions.title: 更新公众号菜单
actions.description: 更新公众号自定义菜单；执行前必须展示并确认完整菜单。

actions.title: 发送客服文本消息
actions.description: 在平台允许的客服消息窗口内向一个已知用户发送文本。

resources.label: 公众号内容创作
resources.description: 创作符合公众号图文结构的标题、摘要、正文与 CTA。

resources.label: 卡片与素材适配
resources.description: 将工作区卡片与图片适配为公众号封面和正文素材。

resources.label: 草稿与发布
resources.description: 管理草稿、预览、发布确认和发布状态。

resources.label: 评论运营
resources.description: 查看、筛选、回复、精选和处理文章评论。

resources.label: 消息自动化
resources.description: 设计安全的私信回复策略，并在当前可用客服窗口内发送经确认的消息。

resources.label: 粉丝与菜单运营
resources.description: 理解关注者范围并审查、更新公众号自定义菜单。

resources.label: 公众号运营复盘
resources.description: 从草稿、发布和评论证据中整理运营复盘与下一步建议。
